meta.source: fresh harvest scan at the user's tap 2026-10-27 -- three parallel sweeps: (a) arXiv math.CO/math.NT; (b) arXiv math.PR/math.NA/math.GM/cs.DM/cs.SC; (c) math blogs, public GitHub repos, Zenodo records and lab announcements. arXiv IDs below verified on their abs pages; the CFSG repo, the Anthropic formal-math ETH folder, the lattice-packing repo, the Coleman repo, the weighing-matrices repo/Zenodo archive and the E8/T32 Zenodo record verified live. Coverage caveats: arXiv submissions dated Oct 27 were not yet announced at scan time (announcements ~20:00 ET), so the Oct 27 submission slice is unswept, not empty; math.PR screening was search-based rather than a full listing enumeration; three math.NT IDs (2610.34973, 2610.34912, 2610.34822) could not be identified after arXiv 429s, with pure-theory neighbours, so residual risk is low but nonzero. Note on claim 2: it is a DISTINCT Anthropic artifact for the same theorem as the OpenAI ETH disproof audited CLOSED PASS 2026-10-27 -- different claimant, repo, commit and provenance; it is harvested at claimant level, and the independence question (both labs date the discovery to Oct 16) is a recon question, not a settled fact.
